about.heading: About the Conference
paragraphs: The Issachar Generation Conference (IGC) is the annual youth conference of the Issachar Generation, the youth ministry of RCCG Praise Assembly. It is a gathering of young believers consecrated to know God, understand the times, and experience the power of the Holy Spirit.
The theme for IGC 2026 is **“THE SUPERNATURALS”**: a call for youths to live beyond the ordinary and encounter the God of the supernatural.

story.heading: Who We Are
paragraphs: The Issachar Generation is the youth expression of RCCG Praise Assembly: a company of young believers raised to know God intimately, understand the times, and walk in the power of His Spirit.

For most of our journey we were known as **YAYA**. Last year, under our Youth Pastor, **Deacon Femi Bakare**, the ministry transitioned into **The Issachar Generation**, a name inspired by the sons of Issachar.

scripture.text: …which had understanding of the times, to know what Israel ought to do.

mission.label: Our mission
mission.text: Raising a generation of young believers who have the understanding of times and seasons: knowing what to do per time, knowing how to do it, when to do it, and doing it.

journey.heading: Conference Order
journey.intro: Five seasons, one journey. Every step led us here.

steps.title: The Mandate
steps.text: The journey began with a charge: discovering God's assignment for our generation. This phase was about receiving the Great Commission personally: understanding that our lives are not our own, and that we have been entrusted with the mandate to represent Christ on the earth.

steps.title: Emergence
steps.text: Once the mandate is received, a people must rise. Emergence was the season of stepping out: young believers coming of age, leaving the shadows, taking their place in the family of God, and declaring themselves available to be used by Him.

steps.title: Elevate
steps.text: Having emerged, the call is upward. Elevate was about rising in stewardship: deeper consecration, growth in character, competence, and spiritual capacity, refusing to remain at the level of the ordinary but ascending to the heights God has prepared for us.

steps.title: Kairos
steps.text: Beyond elevation, we learnt that God has a moment for everything. Kairos, the appointed time, taught us to recognize heaven's seasons, to discern what the Spirit is saying in this hour, and to act with understanding, like the sons of Issachar.

steps.title: The Supernaturals
steps.text: Now we step beyond understanding into experience. The Supernaturals is the season where the Spirit's power becomes tangibly real in our everyday lives: gifts, healings, miracles, prophetic living. A company of young people who don't just believe in the supernatural, but visibly live it.

previous.heading: Previous Ministers
previous.intro: Through the years, the Issachar Generation Conference has hosted a fellowship of fathers, teachers, psalmists and revival voices: servants of God who poured into our youths and left deposits that remain with us till today. We honour them.
previous.closing: Their labour over this generation is not in vain. We stand today on the foundations they laid.
